interfaces.name: Navigate
interfaces.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
interfaces.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
interfaces.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

interfaces.name: Rest
interfaces.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
interfaces.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

interfaces.name: Wait
interfaces.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

interfaces.name: Pick up
interfaces.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
interfaces.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Eat
interfaces.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

interfaces.name: Gather accessible material
interfaces.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
interfaces.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
interfaces.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

interfaces.name: Drop
interfaces.function: Place owned units on the ground.
interfaces.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Give
interfaces.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
interfaces.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred. Material transfers also accept exact tenths after food-assessment installation; reserved portions cannot be transferred.

interfaces.name: Message
interfaces.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
interfaces.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

interfaces.name: Learn a public interface
interfaces.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
interfaces.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
interfaces.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

interfaces.name: Request a capability
interfaces.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
interfaces.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
interfaces.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

interfaces.name: Observe wildlife
interfaces.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
interfaces.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
interfaces.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

interfaces.name: Cautious food assessment
interfaces.function: Examine an owned material or consume a measured sample and monitor actual personal effects.
interfaces.costs: Examine: 2 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each. Sample: 5 stationary rounds at 0.5 energy each plus 1 ingestion energy, the specified 0.1–1 resource units and real proportional harm; metabolism continues. Requires health >=80; sample satiety <=90. Reserved material ages and cannot be spent twice.
interfaces.effects: Retain dated sensory and exposure evidence with confounders, never a safety certification or hidden composition. Interrupted, invalidated or fatal work releases only unconsumed surviving escrow. A completed nourishing exposure without injury or another food intake may give modest relief: 1 for 6 rounds, cooldown 12, no stacking. Owned items are located at the carrier, not their old pickup coordinates.

interfaces.name: Build insulating shelter
interfaces.function: Construct a persistent two-by-two branch and packed-grass refuge with a real doorway.
interfaces.costs: 6 owned branch and 8 dry-grass units, 6 consecutive stationary rounds at 2 energy each. Center (x,y), angle in radians, front entrance at local (0,1); stand outside within 0.65 of that entrance. Entire footprint and approach must be clear. Real escrow is released once on interruption or death.
interfaces.effects: Actual interior halves the below-comfort cooling component for 160 rounds. Ambient temperature, heat exposure, ordinary rest and food costs stay unchanged. Cold damage can remain. Maintenance requires separate personal study. No building or ownership reward.

interfaces.name: Maintain shelter covering
interfaces.function: Replace packed-grass insulation on a real existing shelter.
interfaces.costs: 4 owned dry-grass units and 2 consecutive stationary rounds at 1 energy each within 0.65 of the actual entrance. Escrow ages and is released once on interruption or death.
interfaces.effects: Restores remaining cold protection to 160 rounds, never adds beyond 160. Expired walls remain real obstacles. No direct healing, food, rest bonus or completion reward.

satisfactionSources.name: Nature appreciation
satisfactionSources.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

satisfactionSources.name: Cautious food relief
satisfactionSources.rationale: Modest relief follows personally experienced nourishment from completed monitored exposure without adverse or confounding evidence. Examination, labels and absence of evidence do not certify safety or earn reward.

satisfactionSources.name: Thermal refuge
satisfactionSources.rationale: Three consecutive stationary resting/waiting rounds with measured avoided cold loss and lower cold discomfort, without starvation or health loss. Ownership, construction, application and study alone do not qualify.

request.name: Active warming
request.function: Perform stationary physical exercise to generate modest bodily warmth during cold exposure.
request.conditions: Alive, sufficient energy and satiety, and not already overheated. Review whether physical exercise can safely mitigate the currently observed cooling.
request.inputs: Personal physical effort; no assumed equipment or hidden resources.
request.costs: Real simulation time, meaningful energy expenditure and ordinary metabolism; no energy recovery during exercise.
request.effects: A bounded physiological warming effect based on actual exertion, with ambient cooling continuing and overheating prevented. No healing, permanent cold immunity or direct satisfaction award. Expose actual temperature and energy changes so effectiveness can be evaluated.

input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
